decision.title: The XQuery API and the sxml xquery command (packet )

body.p: , after , , . include/sxml/xquery.h is implemented in src/xquery.c; no header changed.

item.p: One evaluation path: src/xpath.c exports its context checks and the evaluation of a sealed unit through src/xpath_api_internal.h (sxml_static_context_configuration_is_valid, sxml_processor_static_context, sxml_dynamic_context_configuration_is_valid, sxml_evaluate_unit, glossary ); the XQuery API compiles with the same static context and evaluates through the same function. Globals are bound by name except the context global (name 0), which no binding reaches. The unit's static base URI (the host's or a base-uri declaration's) is the one evaluation uses.

Compiling: src/xquery.c parses with sxml_xquery_build_ast (a library module is XPST0003, as the header says), compiles with the new sxml_xquery_compile_module (src/xquery_lower_internal.h: lower, passes, seal over a caller's AST; sxml_xquery_compile is now parse + that) and reads the output declarations from the AST it kept. Module import stays UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE until 3.11 (the resolver hook is the header's).

Output declarations: option names resolve against the unit's static namespaces (sxml_xpath_resolve_name); declarations in the serialization namespace become sxml_serialization_parameter_texts (glossary) read by sxml_serialization_parameter_reader_read_texts (src/serialize_internal.h), one reader per query owning the views: the parameter document first, then the declarations over it, method xml when nothing names one. The textual decoding is the parameter document's (src/serialize_parameters.c now decodes a value attribute and a declaration with one function; QNames resolve with a binding view, first binding of a prefix wins), so xsl:output can use it in Phase 4. Errors are static at the declaration: a value a parameter does not permit SEPM0016 (SESU0007/SESU0011 for encodings and normalization forms), XQST0119 when the document cannot be loaded (processor's resolver, kind XML_DOCUMENT, resolved against the static base URI), XQST0115 when it is not a valid parameter document. XQST0108 waits for library modules (3.11).
QT4 driver: the adapter () is deleted; the driver calls include/sxml/xquery.h and has no src/ include any more.

CLI: sxml xquery (QUERY-FILE | --expression=TEXT), sxml serialize [--method] [--indent] FILE, and sxml xpath --method with adaptive, xml, xhtml, html, text, json. --param declares and binds for XPath, only binds for XQuery (the query declares it external; a host declaration would make the prolog's XQST0049). The three commands share apps/sxml/query_command.{c,h} (glossary ). --output/--force stay planned: the CLI framework has no file writer.

WebAssembly: the CLI module grows from 1.83 MB to 3.45 MB stripped (767 KB gzipped) with the XQuery grammar; javascript/size_budget allows 3,700,000 / 820,000 for the CLI (Proposed below). sxml.wasm (1.83 MB) is unchanged; compileQuery() in the JavaScript package is left out because it would link the same grammar into it.
